scope: English base main v1.2 + base glossary + official base FAQ; exclude solo and Marine Worlds

questions.question: What are the starting money, active and inactive workers, zoo-card draw/keep counts, Final Scoring cards, Action card order/sides and appeal by turn order?
How do base-project setup and blocked spaces differ between two, three and four players, and when is the initial display revealed?
After using a card in slot 4, how do Action cards move? When is strength fixed, what can X-tokens do, what is the holding limit, and when do after-finishing effects occur?
Can you perform an action doing nothing? Explain the alternative X-token action, card movement, and its limit.
When a break is triggered during a turn, what happens to excess movement, the triggering reward, the remaining turn and next turn?
State both Cards-action options on sides I and II, snap thresholds, reputation restriction, break movement, display refill timing and hand-limit timing.
How does reputation range work, what blocks reputation 10+, what happens above 15, and can you inspect the discard pile?
State the Build I and II limits, money cost, legal first/later placement, unavailable spaces, kiosk spacing and pavilion reward.
Which enclosures are available with Build I versus II; how many of each special enclosure; can Build create unique buildings; and what happens when the map is fully covered?
Can money or other bonuses gained during an action pay for a later building, animal or association task in that action? How do immediate and after-finishing effects and simultaneous effects differ?
Describe animal play requirements, payment with a matching partner zoo and double continent icons, standard and special enclosure occupancy, water/rock requirements and effect timing.
What does Animals II add for display play, extra cost, strength-5 reputation timing, refill timing and upgrade-required animals?
When may existing animals move into a Reptile House or Large Bird Aviary, which and how many may move, how is capacity marked and which standard enclosure becomes empty, including fallback?
Give the four Association task strengths, side-I/II task limits, worker requirements when repeating a task before a break, and whether other players workers matter.
Where do partner zoos and universities come from and go, can duplicates be acquired, how are bonuses handled, and what are partner and hand-limit restrictions?
How may a Conservation Project enter play, what are support conditions/once limits, where does its token come from, when is the uncovered bonus taken, and what happens to overflowing projects/tokens?
For release projects, must printed standard enclosure size match exactly; what appeal/icons/reputation/conservation are lost or retained, and how do you free enclosure space?
Explain Sponsors I versus II level budget, display use/cost, resolving multiple sponsors, and the money option when only one break step remains.
Give break steps in order, hand limit, kiosk qualifying neighbors and income order/refill when several players take display cards.
State conservation milestone rewards at 2,5,8,10; exact end trigger timing including gains on another player turn; last turns; Final Scoring cap; victory-point formula and tiebreak.
